tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Search the Vibesignet template library. Returns matching templates with their key, sector, look and a one-line description. No access key needed. Call with no arguments to list every template.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: One template's public details: what it is for, its sections in order with a one-line summary each, how many photographs and films the build needs, and its page on vibesignet.com. No access key needed.

tools.name: get_prompt
tools.description: The full build prompt for one template. Needs the user's Vibesignet access key, sent as the Authorization header of this connection or as the access_key argument. A free key unlocks 1 template of the user's choice; fetching it again is free.

tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Search the Vibesignet components: single scenes, backgrounds, interactions and sections, each one standalone, to drop into an existing site. Returns each component's id, kind and one line. No access key needed. Call with no arguments to list them all.

tools.name: get_component_prompt
tools.description: The full build prompt for one component. Needs the access key of a paid Vibesignet plan (Monthly, Yearly or Founders), sent as the Authorization header or as access_key. Components have their own allowance (15 new in any 30 days on Monthly) and never use a template unlock; fetching one again is free

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_prompt" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
